items.title: Phillips 66 (PSX) Stock May Still Be A Bargain As Strong Q3 Earnings Land
items.summary: Phillips 66 has delivered a powerful run over the past few years, yet the recent pullback puts a spotlight back on a basic question for you as a shareholder: Are you now paying a price that is still grounded in what the refiner is actually earning? Over 5 years the stock has returned 291.4%, which places significant emphasis on whether the current earnings base can support that kind of re-rating. items.title: What’s Going On With Phillips 66 (PSX)?
items.summary: Phillips 66 (PSX) has linked its fuel brands to the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games, agreeing to supply gasoline, renewable diesel and propane for event vehicles, venues and the nationwide Torch Relay. Recent price action has been choppy for Phillips 66, with the share price down 7.68% over the past week and 16.60% over the past month, even though the year to date share price return is 85.89% and the 5 year total shareholder return is 291.36%. This points to strong long term momentum...

items.title: Your Chevron Hedge Works Only While Oil Spikes
items.summary: Our Nov 18 look at Chevron found the stock moving on its own. Chevron gained 2.3% from November 10 to November 17, while the S&P 500 lost 2.4%. For the full record, see Is Chevron Stock Increasing Your Market Risk? The next question is whether Chevron protects a portfolio when oil prices jump.
